criteria.description: Every decisions-lock acquisition in doctor decisions --repair, owned next and agent decision repair-runtime-lock goes through decisions/service.py::_decisions_lock; no command keeps a local LockAcquireTimeout translation or a duplicated wait constant.
criteria.evidence: src/specify_cli/decisions/service.py::_decisions_lock is the only translation; _decisions_doctor.py imports the service's _LOCK_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_S (local copy deleted), next_cmd._commit_owned_next_mutations and decision._repair_runtime_lock call _decisions_lock. tests: test_decisions_reconciler.py, test_next_owned_lock_timeout.py, test_owned_decision_runtime_lock.py
criteria.notes: Reviewed in the WP rounds; grep shows no remaining machine_file_lock acquisition for decisions/index.json.lock outside the seam.

criteria.description: doctor decisions --repair reports a lock timeout as the C2 refusal (human and --json), exits 1 and writes nothing; a free lock still repairs and exits 0.
criteria.notes: Pre-fix these raised LockAcquireTimeout (captured red), post-fix exit 1 with DECISION_LOCK_TIMEOUT and a byte-identical decisions tree.

criteria.description: The doctor's additive coordination-only ledger copy refuses through the same seam before copying a single DM-*.md.
criteria.notes: Asserts DecisionError code LOCK_TIMEOUT and an unchanged ledger tree.

criteria.description: An owned next whose commit step cannot take the lock reports the refusal in next's own error contract (error_code + next_step, human and --json), exits 1, prints no decision; a free lock still commits and prints.
criteria.notes: Pre-fix the dispatch let LockAcquireTimeout escape with no document.

criteria.description: agent decision repair-runtime-lock reports a lock timeout with code DECISION_LOCK_TIMEOUT in its {status, code, message} shape, exits 1 and leaves the checkout untouched; a free lock still repairs.
criteria.notes: Acquire-time timeout path: untracked lock, byte-identical checkout and preserved lock inode. A busy tracked lock still refuses at the pre-existing preflight (characterisation row); follow-up #6836.

negative_invariants.description: No command keeps a local `except LockAcquireTimeout` translation for the decisions sidecar lock; the one seam owns it.
negative_invariants.evidence: only src/specify_cli/decisions/service.py maps LockAcquireTimeout to DecisionError(LOCK_TIMEOUT)

negative_invariants.description: The doctor has no duplicated wait constant; the service's _LOCK_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_S is the single wait authority.
negative_invariants.evidence: the module imports the service constant; it defines none

negative_invariants.description: No new error code is introduced for these refusals.
negative_invariants.evidence: the code is DecisionErrorCode.LOCK_TIMEOUT's existing value; tests assert it in all three commands
